text: dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn 是面向 DSH Web 的 Tencent WorkBuddy 模型提供方，通过 DSH 的 LLM adapter 接口注册 WorkBuddy 模型。用户可在设置页通过浏览器登录中国或国际站账号，在模型选择器中使用动态模型目录，并进行流式对话；Web 侧还提供账号状态和额度用量提示。适合希望在 DSH Web 中使用 WorkBuddy 模型并查看账户额度的用户。需要 WorkBuddy 账号，不需要 API key。

dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn connects Tencent WorkBuddy to DSH Web as an LLM provider. Sign in to either site from Settings, browse its model catalog, and use selected models for streaming chat. The Web client shows account status and usage. A WorkBuddy account is required; no API key is needed.
想在 DSH Web 里登录 WorkBuddy 并用它的模型聊天。
能不能在侧边栏看到 WorkBuddy 账户的用量额度？
How can I use WorkBuddy models for streaming chat in DSH Web?
dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn 的功能「WorkBuddy 对话」：将 WorkBuddy 注册为 DSH 模型提供方，用户选择目录中的模型后即可进行流式聊天。
dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn 的功能「账户用量显示」：在 Web 侧边栏展示 WorkBuddy 个人或企业账户的用量比例与额度信息。登录后由侧边栏用量指示器读取 meter 数据，并以条形或圆环提示当前使用情况。
dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn 会向所选 WorkBuddy 站点请求登录、模型目录、聊天和账户用量服务；登录凭据通过浏览器 OAuth 获取，无需 API key。
dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 31 天；提交数 1；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn README · dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn：**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) plugin for **Tencent WorkBuddy**.

Sign in through your browser — **no API key required** — and use WorkBuddy's own model list.

dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn README · Features：- **Browser OAuth sign-in** — authorize in a normal browser tab; no API key needed, ever. Sign in to either the China or the international site.
- **Full model catalog** — WorkBuddy's own models, with context windows, output caps, and credit multipliers; server-side additions and removals are picked up automatically.
- **Streaming chat** — responses stream in real time.
- **Tool calls** — function calling, with a clear error when a model does not support it.
- **Reasoning effort** — pick a thinking level for models that support one.
- **Image input** — attach images for vision-capable models (models without vision support may be routed to a different model by the server).
- **Usage indicator** — a quota bar in the Web UI sidebar for both personal and enterprise plans, with an optional custom cap and a configurable danger threshold.

dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn README · Compatibility：| Requirement | Version |
| --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) | `>= 0.1.7-rc.1` |

Web UI features such as the settings page, model picker, and usage indicator require the `web` profile.

dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn README · Install：Add the plugin to a dsh profile — the `web` profile backs the Web UI:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:wenh56884-wq/dsh-llm-workbuddy
```

The repository ships its compiled `lib/`, so a Git install needs no build step and no
dev dependencies. Installing from a source checkout works too:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-llm-workbuddy
```

dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn README · Sign in：Open **Settings → WorkBuddy** in the Web UI and pick a site: **Sign in (China)** for [www.workbuddy.cn](https://www.workbuddy.cn) or **Sign in (Intl)** for [www.workbuddy.ai](https://www.workbuddy.ai). The browser login opens in a new tab; the harness writes the credential automatically. No terminal needed.

dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn README · Sign in：The two sites are the same service on different hosts but hold **separate accounts** — one site's account does not work on the other — so the site is chosen per sign-in and recorded with the credential. Every later request goes to the host that issued it. To move to the other site, sign out and sign in again.

Alternatively, sign in from the terminal:

```bash
dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn README · Sign in to the China site (the default; equivalent to --site cn)：dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-login
section: Sign in to the China site (the default; equivalent to --site cn)

text: dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn README · Sign in to the international site：dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-login --site intl
section: Sign in to the international site

text: dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn README · Show the signed-in account, its site, and the model list：dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-login --status
section: Show the signed-in account, its site, and the model list

text:
dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn README · Remove the stored credential：dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-login --logout
```

Once signed in, WorkBuddy's models appear in the model picker.

dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn README · Build：From a source checkout:

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run build
```

This compiles the host half with `tsc` and bundles the Web client half with `esbuild`, both into `lib/`.

dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn README · Provenance and license：MIT. This plugin is a WorkBuddy adaptation of
[`@shatyuka/dsh-llm-codebuddy`](https://github.com/shatyuka/dsh-llm-codebuddy)
(MIT, © 2026 Shatyuka), which is the original work it derives from: the host
architecture, the browser-OAuth handshake, the model-catalog reader, the
settings page, and the usage indicator are all its author's design. This
repository re-points that client at the WorkBuddy deployments — the site list,
the product token every request identifies itself as, and the provider,
settings, and credential identifiers are WorkBuddy's — and renames it
accordingly. The upstream copyright notice is retained in
[`LICENSE`](./LICENSE) as the license requires.

dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn README · Provenance and license：When the upstream project releases fixes, they can be diffed in against this
tree: the changes here are confined to the identifiers, the two service roots
in `src/constants.ts`, and the catalogue User-Agent documented there.
